item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will moderate gradually today and tomorrow. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China towards the weekend to early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Sunday. The weather will be slightly cooler over the region early to midweek next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the central part of the South China Sea will edge closer to the central to northern parts of Vietnam today. It will then move inland and dissipate gradually. Tropical Cyclone Pulasan will move towards the vicinity of the coast of eastern China today and tomorrow.
